mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comments (id, post_id, author_id, parent_id, reply_to_user_id, content) VALUES (#{id}, #{postId}, #{authorId}, #{parentId}, #{replyToUserId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id AS postId, c.author_id AS authorId, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.reply_to_user_id AS replyToUserId, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.avatar AS authorAvatar FROM post_comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.status = 'active'

SELECT c.id, c.post_id AS postId, c.author_id AS authorId, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.reply_to_user_id AS replyToUserId, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.avatar AS authorAvatar FROM post_comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.status = 'active' ORDER BY COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id), c.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
